name: Mortal Kombat: Deadly Alliance — Kitana Ending
notes: Official Mortal Kombat: Deadly Alliance Kitana ending reproduced by Mortal Kombat Warehouse, used as preservation/access infrastructure rather than canonical authority. The ending explicitly portrays Shao Kahn as dead. Later Original-continuity primary biographies in Deception establish that Shao Kahn had created a clone to draw enemies while he escaped and later personally encountered Goro, so this earlier blanket death portrayal is retained as retconned evidence rather than promoted to current canon.
